decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align:justify;text-indent:-18.0pt;
mso-list:l0 level1 lfo1;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:none">&nbsp; &nbsp; The proposed single storey rear extension and the proposed first floor rear extension,&nbsp;by reason of their rearward projection,&nbsp;siting and height, would result in unreasonable loss of outlook, light and overshadowing and&nbsp;would be detrimental to the residential&nbsp;amenities of the neighbouring occupiers at no. 6 Church Avenue, contrary to Policy&nbsp; D3 (7) of The London Plan (2021) and policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
description: Relocation of entrance to front elevation, Single and two storey side to rear extension, Juliette balcony to first floor rear elevation, Patio to rear, External alterations (Demolition of side conservatory and outbuilding at rear)
